name: Welcome to Wrexham
description: Documentary series tracking the dreams and worries of Wrexham, a working-class town in North Wales, UK, as two Hollywood stars (Rob McElhenney and Ryan Reynolds) take ownership of the town’s historic yet struggling football club.

videos.title: Dream
videos.overview: Hollywood stars Ryan Reynolds and Rob McElhenney attempt a takeover of the world’s third oldest professional football (a.k.a. soccer) club, located in Wrexham, a working class town in northern Wales in the United Kingdom.

videos.title: Reality
videos.overview: Wrexham Football Club attempts to qualify for the playoffs as their new owners try to (very quickly) learn the ins and outs of a game and an industry they know nothing about.

videos.title: Rebuilding
videos.overview: With just weeks before the season begins, Rob McElhenney and Ryan Reynolds find themselves having to convince star football players and executives to take a chance on Wrexham.

videos.title: Home Opener
videos.overview: The first Wrexham home opener of the new era arrives, whether Rob McElhenney and Ryan Reynolds are ready for it or not.

videos.title: Fearless
videos.overview: Ryan Reynolds and Rob McElhenney land an important partnership as the Wrexham goalies - and fans - face some tough contests.

videos.title: Hamilton!
videos.overview: Ryan Reynolds and Rob McElhenney try to fulfill one of their biggest promises to Wrexham as a previous owner’s dark shadow still lingers.

videos.title: Wide World of Wales
videos.overview: In this "very special episode", Ryan Reynolds and Rob McElhenney take us through on a tour of Wales - and TV show formats.

videos.title: Away We Go
videos.overview: Wrexham Chairmen Ryan Reynolds and Rob McElhenney make a surprise appearance at an away game to watch Wrexham play in person for the very first time.

videos.title: Welcome Home
videos.overview: After a year of cheering from afar due to Covid, Co-Chairmen Ryan Reynolds and Rob McElhenney finally get to visit Wrexham and spend time with their team and the town.

videos.title: Hooligans
videos.overview: Unfortunate occurrences at the first home game attended by the Co-Chairmen lead to a police investigation and raise the ugly specter of football Hooliganism.

videos.title: Sack the Gaffer
videos.overview: Fans grumble about Wrexham's lackluster performance and aim their ire at manager Phil Parkinson. Ryan Reynolds and Rob McElhenney debate his future with the club.

videos.title: Wins and Losses
videos.overview: Wrexham AFC begin to play up to their potential while off the field challenges put match play in perspective.

videos.title: Worst Team in the League
videos.overview: Roster changes threaten Wrexham's momentum as they prepare to face the worst team in the league.

videos.title: A Hollywood Distraction
videos.overview: Ryan Reynolds surprises the team with a visit as Wrexham prepares for the biggest match of the season against Stockport County, their rivals for promotion.

videos.title: Daggers
videos.overview: With one match left to play in the regular season, Wrexham has a chance to win the league and promotion.

videos.title: Hello Wembley
videos.overview: Hollywood stars and Wrexham residents descend on London for the Red Dragons' big match at legendary Wembley Stadium.

videos.title: Wromance
videos.overview: An inside look at the unusual beginnings and dynamics of Ryan Reynolds and Rob McElhenney's football friendship.

videos.title: Do or Die
videos.overview: For the first time in 14 years, Wrexham has a chance to be promoted out of the National League. Can they do it?

videos.title: Welcome Back to Wrexham
videos.overview: A new football season begins as the town, the team and owners Ryan Reynolds and Rob McElhenney prepare to welcome King Charles III.

videos.title: The Quiet Zone
videos.overview: Wrexham striker Paul Mullin tackles challenges on and off the pitch as we meet Wrexham superfan Millie Tipping.

videos.title: Nott Yet
videos.overview: Wrexham are playing well but their hopes for promotion are under threat thanks to the amazing play of a surging rival – Notts County.

videos.title: Shaun's Vacation
videos.overview: Some self-inflicted chaos unfolds in Wrexham thanks to Co-Chairmen Ryan Reynolds and Rob McElhenney, much to the frustration of Executive Director Humphrey Ker.

videos.title: First Losers
videos.overview: After a second place finish last season and with Notts County challenging for first place, Wrexham AFC focuses on building a winning mentality.

videos.title: Ballers
videos.overview: The most dominant football team in Wales takes the pitch as they race toward promotion while juggling their day jobs.

videos.title: Giant Killers
videos.overview: The FA Cup provides Wrexham a chance to live up to its storied past and to take on teams playing many leagues above them.

videos.title: The Grind
videos.overview: Injuries, the weather and a brutal schedule test Wrexham AFC as the team enters do or die time.

videos.title: Glove Triangle
videos.overview: The return of Rob Lainton complicates the goalie situation while Co-Chairmen Rob McElhenney and Ryan Reynolds make a difficult roster decision.

videos.title: Gresford
videos.overview: The darkest day in Wrexham history looms over the team and town as they try to shift to a winning mentality.

videos.title: Yn Codi
videos.overview: The Wrexham Women's Team battle for promotion and try to set a Welsh attendance record at the Racecourse.

videos.title: Hand of Foz
videos.overview: Wrexham AFC and Notts County clash at the Racecourse in the biggest match in the history of the National League.

videos.title: Family Business
videos.overview: Family is everything for the members of Wrexham AFC and we meet the fathers, mothers, daughters and sons behind some key people.

videos.title: Worst Case Scenario
videos.overview: With promotion still up in the air, Co-Chairmen Rob McElhenney and Ryan Reynolds bring in friends and sponsors to help raise the Club's profile.

videos.title: Up the Town?
videos.overview: Wrexham faces either promotion or the dreaded playoffs.

videos.title: Welcome to the EFL
videos.overview: Wrexham AFC play a series of summer "friendlies" in America and have a less than friendly return to the English Football League.

videos.title: Goals
videos.overview: New players take the pitch and a shocking departure surprises Wrexham as the team tries to find its footing.

videos.title: Notts Again
videos.overview: The Wrexham Women's Team adapt to life in the top Welsh league as the men prepare to face Notts County, their fiercest rivals from the National League.

videos.title: Risky Business
videos.overview: The Birthday Prank War between Co-Chairmen Rob McElhenney and Ryan Reynolds escalates as Wrexham is reminded of the fragility of the city's rebound on and off the field.

videos.title: Temporary
videos.overview: 99-year-old Wrexham fan Arthur Massey reflects on his life as a supporter as his 100th birthday approaches and the Club continues to struggle with the new Kop football stand.

videos.title: Far Away, So Close
videos.overview: Wrexham's global impact can be felt as far away as Patagonia and The Gambia but the team can't seem to win away from the Racecourse.

videos.title: Proper Trouble
videos.overview: With a rise in yellow cards and continuing poor form away from home, Wrexham AFC risk being relegated to the playoffs while the women's side prepare to tackle new challenges.

videos.title: Down to the Wire
videos.overview: Wrexham AFC's poor away form casts doubt on their chances for promotion, and as the end of the season nears, Rob McElhenney and Ryan Reynolds face some very tough decisions.

videos.title: All In?
videos.overview: Wrexham AFC enters the ultra-competitive EFL League One while owners Ryan Reynolds and Rob McElhenney confront the financial costs of remaining competitive. Humphrey Ker makes a big commitment.

videos.title: High Hopes
videos.overview: Wrexham AFC spar with League One rival Birmingham City and its owner Tom Brady. A Ukrainian family start a small business in the city of Wrexham.

videos.title: Disney FC
videos.overview: Owners Rob Mac and Ryan Reynolds experience Anxiety and Fear while trying to remain Happy and not Grumpy in this emotionally Tangled episode. Will the Reds Wish to keep going UP continue or will they have to Let it Go?

videos.title: Built to Last
videos.overview: Channing Tatum brings his magic to Wrexham while a few aging stars step forward at just the right time. Wrexham tries to build a youth academy to set them up for the long run.

videos.title: Anything's Possible
videos.overview: The January transfer window provides a moment for the Club, its owners and its fans to contemplate losses, imagine futures and sign the best fricking players available.

videos.title: Red Dragons
videos.overview: As Wrexham AFC's promotion chances hang on nine final matches, the Club faces change on all fronts: strikers Paul Mullin and Ollie Palmer starting spots come into question while Shaun Harvey finds purpose beyond the boardroom.

videos.title: Life or Death
videos.overview: Wrexham's promotion chances hang in the balance when a tragic occurrence at Wycombe puts everything in perspective.

videos.title: Do a Wrexham
videos.overview: Wrexham and Wycombe stage a dramatic battle for the final automatic promotion spot as the entire town wonders if Wrexham's bad luck is about to return.

videos.title: The Heart of Wrexham
videos.overview: In a tough new league with a mostly new squad, Wrexham fans and co-chairmen Rob Mac and Ryan Reynolds try to keep focus on what makes Wrexham "Wrexham."

videos.title: Joey Jones
videos.overview: The team struggles to stay out of the relegation zone as the town honors the legacy of Joey Jones, one of Wrexham's footballing legends.

videos.title: Coming Together
videos.overview: The pressure on Wrexham AFC mounts as the pricey new players struggle to gel while the women's team adjusts to a new leader.

videos.title: Wales Forever
videos.overview: As Wrexham and Swansea City prepare for a Welsh showdown, Nathan Broadhead, Lili Jones and the players of the Wrexham AFC Powerchair Team exemplify the Welsh spirit.

videos.title: Holiday Spirit
videos.overview: After a crushing loss leaves Wrexham spiraling at Christmastime, a big FA Cup matchup against a Premier League opponent gives goalie Arthur Okonkwo a shot at redemption.

videos.title: Hell Week
videos.overview: Wrexham AFC plays three high stakes matches in seven days including hosting legendary Premier League club Chelsea. Co-Chairmen Rob Mac and Ryan Reynolds prepare to broadcast a match.

videos.title: Touching Grass
videos.overview: With Wrexham fighting for a position in the playoffs and perhaps promotion to the Premier League, Phil Parkinson tries to keep his squad - and himself - grounded.

videos.title: We Go Again
videos.overview: Wrexham AFC and two other clubs fight for the last playoff spot as the Reds' chances at being promoted to the Premier League come down to the final days and, in typical Wrexham fashion, seconds.

awards: Won 10 Primetime Emmys. 14 wins & 24 nominations total
